title: Project watch rules (.kotilo/watch.json) v1
description: Rules a project adds to the user's watch rules (D-083). Used only after the user trusts the project in Settings; they can only add warnings, never block a call or turn off the user's rules. The hub prefixes every id with "project.". Limits: file at most 64 KB, first 50 rules used. Comments and trailing commas are accepted.

rule.description: All fields that are present must match; any item of a list is enough for that field.

name.description: Shown on the permission card, the timeline and the toast.

notify.description: false: badge and timeline mark only, no toast.

command.description: .NET regular expression run without backtracking (no lookarounds, backreferences or atomic groups), case-insensitive, against the tool's command.

paths.description: Glob patterns matched against the project-relative and the absolute file path.
